outcome: Give game studio cto / live operations director a governed method to improve crash-free sessions by version using client crash dumps, hardware variants and patch cohorts, with final decisions…
overview: Game Crash Cluster Root-Cause addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in gaming and esports operations. The first proof of value uses client crash dumps, hardware variants and patch cohorts. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is crash-free sessions by version, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: client crash dumps, hardware variants and patch cohorts; define crash-free sessions by version and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Game Studio CTO / Live Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for crash-free sessions by version
